limitations: No production deployment is claimed by this artifact; the only production database mutations were the authorized REVIEWING status, response and internal route updates for the six new feedback reports.
No warehouse lifecycle, fiscal, provider-delivery, pricing or inventory-transfer rule was invented.
WhatsApp PDF attachment remains intentionally blocked; direct sending was removed because quotes can contain medication or clinical-adjacent concepts.
Connected PostgreSQL purchase persistence must be repeated after deployment before the feedback can be marked resolved.
